channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Laqshya Media Group Executes India’s First Luxury Automotive Anamorphic Activation for Defender
item.description: Laqshya Media Group has executed India’s first luxury automotive anamorphic activation, delivering a large-scale 3D Defender showcase in Mumbai and other key cities.

item.title: NODWIN Gaming Announces Mumbai Comic Con 2026 for May 9–10
item.description: NODWIN Gaming has announced that Mumbai Comic Con 2026 will be held on May 9–10 at Jio World Convention Centre, bringing together fans, creators and pop culture communities for a two-day celebration.

item.title: DNA Entertainment Networks Delivers Structured ‘Sportainment’ Experience Across All ICC Men’s T20 World Cup Venues
item.description: DNA Entertainment Networks is delivering a structured “Sportainment” framework across all eight ICC Men’s T20 World Cup venues, integrating live entertainment, fan activations and dynamic stadium production elements.

item.title: Hoopr Secures Strategic Investment from The Chennai Angels in Pre-Series A Round
item.description: Hoopr has welcomed The Chennai Angels as investors in its Pre-Series A round, citing strategic backing to reform music licensing in India and scale its platform.

item.title: Shangri-La Bengaluru Appoints Rakesh Ramachandran as Director of Events
item.description: Shangri-La Bengaluru has appointed Rakesh Ramachandran as Director of Events, bringing over two decades of hospitality experience to lead its conventions and events portfolio.

item.title: Applicable Insurances for Your Upcoming 2026 Holi Event
item.description: PROADVICE Wealth IMF Pvt Ltd provides insurance solutions that help event organizers manage Holi-related risks — from crowd safety to cancellations — while protecting execution and reputation.

item.title: PepsiCo Elevates Amit Kumar Nanchahal as Brand Communications Head – International Beverages
item.description: PepsiCo has appointed Amit Kumar Nanchahal as Brand Communications Head – International Beverages, overseeing global communications for Sting Energy and Mountain Dew.

item.title: Songs of the Stone Returns to Qutub Minar with Rakesh Chaurasia Performance on 8 March
item.description: Songs of the Stone will return on 8 March 2026 at Qutub Minar, featuring Grammy-winning flautist Rakesh Chaurasia in a heritage-based musical evening curated by Inkpot India.

item.title: Hotel And Restaurant Association (Western India) Concludes Knowledge Series – I in Pune, Focuses on Regulatory Reforms Shaping Hospitality Sector
item.description: HRAWI’s Knowledge Series – I in Pune brought together hospitality leaders for detailed sessions on Labour Codes, DPDP compliance, GST changes and the Maharashtra Tourism Policy 2024.

item.title: Kochi Comic Con to Debut in Kerala; Artist Line-up Announced for Maiden Edition
item.description: Kochi Comic Con will debut in Kerala on February 28–March 1, 2026, featuring Dan Parent, leading Indian comic creators and a weekend of music, comedy and gaming at Adlux Convention Center.
